title: CPSC, Dolgencorp Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Xylophones Sold at Dollar General Stores
summary: The red mallet sold with the toy xylophone can get lodged in the throats of young children, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 113,000.

title: CPSC, Window Covering Industry Announce Recall to Repair Window Blinds
summary: The recall involves millions of window blinds with pull cords and inner cords that can form a loop and cause strangulation. Units: About 85 million each year.

title: CPSC, Three Firms Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
summary: These helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer severe head injuries or death. Units: About 243,000.

title: Curious George Musical Pull Toys Recalled by Prestige Toy Corp.
summary: The toy has two elastic cords that form a loop, posing a strangulation risk to young children. Units: About 4,600.

title: Electric Fans Recalled by Agis Enterprises Co.
summary: The fans could overheat during use, present an electrocution hazard and do not have sufficient guards to prevent fingers from contacting the fan blades, posing the risk of finger amputations. Units: About 11,800.

title: CPSC, Emerson Tool Co. Announce Recall of Craftsman® Radial Arm Saws Sold by Sears, Roebuck and Co.
summary: These radial arm saws were sold without a guard that covers the entire blade. Consumers have come into contact with the blade or have been hit by pieces of wood kicked back by the saws, resulting in severe injuries. Units: About 3.7 million.

title: CPSC, AMSAFE Commercial Products Inc. Announce Recall of Go-Kart Seat Belts
summary: The seatbelts on these go-karts can unintentionally unlatch, posing a risk of serious injury to riders. Units: About 1,150.

title: CPSC, Honda Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: A mounting bracket on the front suspension of the Honda Rancher TRX350 models could be welded improperly to the frame. title: CPSC, Kole Imports Announce Recall of Circuit Testers
summary: The circuit testers can fail to indicate if electric current is present, posing a risk of electric shock to consumers. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, Liebert Corp. Announce Recall of Cooling System
summary: An electric heating element inside the system, that is used primarily in the dehumidification process, can short circuit and produce sparks, posing a smoke and fire risk. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Five-Y Clothing Announce Recall of Fleece Sweatshirts Sold at Kmart
summary: These garments, which fail to meet the federal mandatory standards for fabric flammability, could ignite easily and present a serious risk of burn injuries. Units: About 42,000.

title: CPSC, Lifetime Hoan Corp. Announce Recall of Fondue Sets to Replace Burners
summary: Some sets have alcohol burners that can produce high flames beyond the intended-cooking surface of the fondue pot. Another set, which uses chafing fuel, is being recalled because the chafing fuel holder could tip as it burns down. Both problems present potential fire and burn hazards to consumers. U

title: CPSC, Profile Design Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
summary: The stem connects the bicycle's handlebars to the fork. These stems can break during use, causing the bicycle rider to crash and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Stack-On Products Co. Announce Recall of Gun Cabinets
summary: The gun cabinets have push button locks that can be opened without the use of a key, allowing unauthorized access to firearms. Units: About 3,300.

title: CPSC, Cosco Announce Recall to Repair High Chairs
summary: The high chairs are adjustable and have both recline and upright positions. In the recline position, the seats can separate from the frame and fall to the ground. In the upright position, the seats can slip from their set height position to the lowest position or can fall to the ground. Additionally

title: CPSC, Cooper Lighting Announce Recall of Recessed Lights
summary: The glass ring exterior portion or trim of these lights can fall from the fixture, posing a risk of lacerations and impact injuries. Units: About 34,000.

title: CPSC, Honda Announce Recall of Off-Road Motorcycles
summary: The two bolts that attach the handlebars can break. If the handlebars separate from the motorcycle, the rider loses steering control and can crash, posing the risk of serious injuries. Units: About 22,000.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. Announce Recall of Off-Road Motorcycles
summary: A frame down tube on these motorcycles can crack below the steering head. Use of the motorcycle with a cracked down tube can result in failure of the frame, which can cause the rider to lose control of the motorcycle and crash, resulting in injury or death. Units: About 4,000.

title: CPSC, Small Small World Announce Recall of Plush Rabbit Toy
summary: The eyes on these toys could detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 22,000.

title: Desk Fans Recalled by Morton Paper Co.
summary: The fans could overheat during use, and do not have sufficient guards to prevent possible finger entrapment. These fans present electrocution, shock, fire, and finger amputation hazards. Units: About 4,500.

title: Power Strips and Extension Cords Recalled by Howard Berger
summary: The power strips have undersized wires, lack over-current protection and grounding, and the plastic case is flammable. title: CPSC, General Binding Corp. Announce Recall of Paper Shredders
summary: These paper shredders do not have a protective shield to guard against exposure to the cutting blades. title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Inc. Announce Recall of Toddlers' Slippers
summary: The drawcord around the ankle of these slippers can break and release the toggle used to tighten the drawcord. The toggle presents a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,000.
